title: Barcelona Segway Tour
text: We had a wonderful tour with Denys. He was very informative,  and knowledgeable. He made sure we were comfortable on our segways before departing on our tour. I would recommend this tour to anyone wanting to get a general feel for Barcelona. On a Segway you can see a lot in a short period of time !
author: Chris_F

title: Great fun. The guide Illia is excellent.
text:
Relax. If you are not sure, just stop.
Book 2 hours tour as possible. One hour is not enough. Safe , but for the first tryer, need to be practise more.
author: LAIKUEN_C

title: Danny was the ABSOLUTE...
text: Danny was the ABSOLUTE best! Our group was very intimate with only 5 people! He made sure to explain the safety clearly and was a great guide!  This is a highly recommended activity to do while in Barcelona.  We covered A LOT of ground on the Segways.
author: LYN_T

title: Pleasant tour
text: Pleasant and personalized tour with Alex for our family of 4 people. Good level of adaptation from our guide who spoke perfect French and provided information about the different places visited.
author: JeanL3440

title: Artem was great! We would...
text: Artem was great! We would recommend this tour for anyone.  Perfect way to see the city and figure out where you want to go back to.
author: Doug_E

title: Excellent tour with Artem
text: Great tour with the super cool and well informed Artem. Could not have been more helpful. Really appreciate your assistance. Thoroughly recommend this tour even if you have not done Segway before.
author: Richard_C

title: Awesome Segway city tour
text: The tour guide explained the workings the Segway very well, insuring safety. Deny also made sure we understood how to operate the vehicle.
